# Products Assessments

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Strategy](../../README.md) • [Assessments](../README.md)**

> Product-specific assessments evaluating individual applications, systems, and technology solutions within the enterprise portfolio. These assessments focus on product architecture quality, modernization needs, technical debt, and alignment with enterprise standards and strategic direction.

page_texts.10:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#product-health-dimensions]

### Product Health Dimensions

Product assessments evaluate applications across key health dimensions:

| Dimension                     | Description                                       | Key Metrics                                                    |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Technical Quality**         | Code quality, architecture, and maintainability   | Code complexity, technical debt score, architecture compliance |
| **Performance & Scalability** | System performance and capacity characteristics   | Response time, throughput, scalability metrics                 |
| **Security & Compliance**     | Security posture and regulatory compliance        | Vulnerability score, compliance percentage, risk rating        |
| **Business Value**            | Strategic alignment and business contribution     | User satisfaction, business process support, ROI               |
| **Operational Excellence**    | Reliability, monitoring, and operational maturity | Uptime, MTTR, operational automation level                     |
page_texts.11:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#assessment-scoring]

### Assessment Scoring

- **Overall Health Score** (1-5 scale)
    - 5: Excellent - Best-in-class implementation
    - 4: Good - Minor improvements needed
    - 3: Acceptable - Some attention required
    - 2: Poor - Significant issues requiring attention
    - 1: Critical - Immediate action required

page_texts.16:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#assessment-lifecycle]

### Assessment Lifecycle

1. **Assessment Planning** - Define scope, objectives, and success criteria
2. **Data Collection** - Gather technical, business, and operational information
3. **Analysis & Evaluation** - Apply assessment framework and scoring methodology
4. **Findings & Recommendations** - Document results and improvement recommendations
5. **Action Planning** - Develop prioritized improvement roadmap
6. **Progress Monitoring** - Track implementation of recommendations and improvements
page_texts.17:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#assessment-governance]

### Assessment Governance

- **Assessment Standards** - Consistent methodology and criteria application
- **Peer Review Process** - Technical and business validation of assessment results
- **Stakeholder Engagement** - Product teams and business stakeholders participation
- **Continuous Improvement** - Regular refinement of assessment processes and criteria

---
page_texts.19:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#regular-assessment-cycles]

### Regular Assessment Cycles

- **Annual Portfolio Review** - Comprehensive assessment of all critical applications
- **Quarterly Health Checks** - Focused assessments of high-risk or strategic products
- **Project-Triggered Assessments** - Evaluations triggered by major changes or issues
- **Modernization Assessments** - Targeted evaluations for modernization planning
page_texts.20:
[strategy/assessments/products/README.md#assessment-prioritization]

### Assessment Prioritization

Assessments are prioritized based on:

- **Business Criticality** - Strategic importance and business impact
- **Technical Risk** - Known issues, technical debt, and stability concerns
- **Modernization Needs** - Age, technology stack, and modernization opportunities
- **Compliance Requirements** - Regulatory or security assessment mandates
